name: Beam Query × Beam Data, 2D Blur
aliases: Beam Query × Beam Data, 2D Blur (Integral of Continuous Photon Beams)
Direct integration of 2D blurred in-scattered radiance
definition: A beam radiance estimate derived by integrating the continuous 2D photon beam in-scattered radiance estimate (Equation 25) along the eye ray (Equation 8).
summary: Beam Query × Beam Data, 2D Blur estimates in-scattered radiance by blurring photon beams in two dimensions perpendicular to their direction, reducing bias compared to 3D blur.
